cli.intro: open-panel — local ops panel for services, sites, processes, and logs. One installable with `install` (WebUI credentials), `client` (desktop GUI), `server` (WebUI), `servers` (roster), and `remote` (probe/install).

cmd.capabilities: Report domain capabilities and their availability
cmd.audit: Read audit records for the current actor
cmd.install: Write local WebUI credentials (`administrator` + strong password, default port 8888). Same path as `npx @wae/open-panel install` and package postinstall
cmd.client: Open the desktop client GUI and pump host events until it closes
cmd.server: Start the local WebUI listener for browser access (reads credentials from install)
cmd.servers: Manage the local multi-server roster used by the client
cmd.servers-list: List managed servers and the active selection
cmd.servers-add: Add or update a managed server entry
cmd.remote: Probe remoting ports and install or upgrade a remote open-panel
cmd.remote-probe: Probe SSH / RDP / WinRM / SMB reachability on a host
cmd.remote-install: Install or upgrade `@wae/open-panel` on a remote host

opt.actor: Audit actor id (user or agent name)
opt.actor-source: Audit actor source (cli, skill, client, server, ...)
opt.content-dir: Directory containing the staged panel UI build
opt.title: Desktop window title
opt.advertise-host: Host shown in the printed login URL after install
opt.install-force: Rotate WebUI credentials even when a credentials file already exists
opt.kind: Filter audit records by actor kind
opt.id: Filter audit records by actor id
opt.capability: Filter audit records by capability id
opt.server-label: Human label for the managed server
opt.password-env: Environment variable that holds the remote password
opt.pack-local: Force packing the local workspace package as a tarball
opt.skip-start: Install without starting `open-panel server` on the remote host
opt.package-url: Bootstrap script URL the remote can fetch (skips controller HTTP staging)
opt.remote-tarball: Known remote filesystem path to a packed `.tgz` already on the host
opt.pack-base-url: Controller pack origin reachable from the remote (overrides auto LAN URL)
